claim: MyVISA T&C clause 9: a Single Entry Visa (SEV) issued through eVISA allows one journey to Malaysia within 6 months of issue; for Foreign Workers, Fly & Cruise and Wedding Tourism categories it is valid 3 months from issue
quote: Single Entry Visa (SEV) obtained through the eVISA system allows for single journey to Malaysia within 6 months from the date of issuance. note: Settles conflict V0038 vs V0039 (with R0006): MyVISA (operator portal, Oct 2026) is newer than the undated HC Dhaka page; 6 months is current for social-visit SEV. note: Settles conflict V0038 vs V0039 together with R0005: MyVISA FAQ and T&C (Oct 2026) both give 6 months; HC Dhaka's undated 3 months is out of date for social visits
